purpose: One real development clip per visible green slice. Clips are added as they become recordable; nobody waits for a monolithic journey.

access_requirements.operator: the operator must drive it: a verification code or a card number is outside what the agent may type

notes: A clip is queued only against a working development path: an authored scenario with no working access is 'authored', not 'recorded'.
Every render registers as Draft with its commit, date and known defects; only a person moves it to Approved after watching.
A rejected clip stays in the catalog as history; a re-render becomes a new clip.
